description: This course applies advanced calculus to practical mathematical problems, and is for students with advanced calculus background and with interest in the applications of calculus. Major topics: Sequences, series, power series. Vector algebra in R2 and R3. Scalar- and vector-valued functions of several variables. Partial derivatives, total differentials. Mean value Theorem. Taylor's formula. Jacobian. Chain rule. Lagrange multiplier. Multiple integrals.
